title: Add script to create GitHub issues from manual test plan
body: ## Summary Adds `scripts/create_manual_test_issues.py`, which reads `docs/release/manual-test-plan.md` and builds one GitHub issue per test case (56 total) with a structured body: test metadata table, scope, run tracker checkboxes, and per-step checkboxes for action / expected / observed. ## Notes The Cloud Agent `gh` token cannot create issues (`Resource not accessible by integration`). A maintainer can run the script locally after `gh auth login` with **issues write** scope, or use `--write-json PATH --export-only` and bulk-create from the JSON. A `manual-test` label was created on the repo for future issue tagging when creation succeeds.
